svg.text: Spark concepts: large, then at 64, 32 and 16 px, on light and dark

g.text: Skewed six: RJ's nav asterisk, grown uneven and leaning forward
Comet five: one long arm trailing down-left, like the period's flight
Sparkle: a four-point glint, tall and leaning
Robot five: chunky rounded arms from the wordmark's own strokes, unevenly set
Ember: three petals and two sparks flying off
Lit period: the lantern dot, throwing three short rays
